prompt_transform.guidance: Convert top-down camera placement into camera position, viewing direction, subject relation, and screen direction.
prompt_transform.template: Camera/Framing: use 2D setup to define camera axis, subject relation, and screen direction.

negative_constraints: Do not ignore camera placement from the director setup.
Do not contradict the planned screen direction.
quality_checks: Prompt maps to at least one camera from the 2D setup.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Shooting plans diagram actor and camera placement.

prompt_transform.guidance: Translate light icons into motivated source, direction, contrast, separation, and spill control.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: 2D setup lights define source direction, contrast, and subject separation.

negative_constraints: Do not replace planned light direction with generic cinematic lighting.
Do not make every light equally bright.
quality_checks: At least one planned light is represented.
Lighting direction is consistent with camera axis.

source_refs.label: B&H cinematic lighting guide
source_refs.note: Light placement affects mood, separation, and realism.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use 2D positions to preserve blocking, distance, foreground/background relation, and occlusion risk.
prompt_transform.template: Scene/Production Design: 2D blocking keeps character distance, foreground relation, and occlusion clear.

negative_constraints: Do not move characters into impossible positions relative to the plan.
Do not hide the main subject behind props unless intended.
quality_checks: Character positions match the top-down setup.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Shooting plans map actors and camera in the set.

prompt_transform.guidance: Translate movement arrows into direction, start/end position, speed, and relationship to camera movement.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: 2D movement arrows define direction, timing, and camera relation.

negative_constraints: Do not reverse movement direction unless requested.
Do not combine subject movement and camera movement in a confusing way.
quality_checks: Start/end relation is clear enough for a video prompt.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Motion prompts should specify direction and speed.
